products.name: Hydrorest Moisturiser Lotion
products.subtitle: Hydrorest Moisturiser Lotion is a lightweight, deeply hydrating formula designed to restore and maintain skin moisture balance. It helps soothe dry and rough skin, improves softness, and provides long-lasting hydration without feeling greasy. Enriched with skin-conditioning ingredients, it keeps your skin smooth, healthy, and refreshed all day. Suitable for daily use and all skin types.

products.name: Nivis Foot Cream
products.subtitle: Nivis Foot Cream is specially formulated to nourish, moisturize, and protect dry, rough, and cracked feet. Enriched with skin-conditioning ingredients, it helps restore softness, improve skin texture, and provide long-lasting hydration. Regular use helps keep feet smooth, healthy, and comfortable throughout the day.
